title: A map whose five keys collide on native conversion, used as a storage key
pattern: The colliding map (u32 1, i32 1, u64 1, string "1", symbol 1) is the contract-data KEY: it sits in the LedgerKey and the event topic. Converting it to a native object collapses the keys and changes the entry identity. js-stellar-sdk#1789.

hazards.placement: colliding ScMap as a ContractData key and event topic
contract-data identity depends on the exact ScVal key

facts.says: The created entry's key is a map with 5 entries.
